basic_profile.bio: I'm a freshman at UCSD, majoring in Electrical Engineering. I recently discovered Reddit and have been using it to connect with fellow students and explore my hobbies. I enjoy blacksmithing and experimenting with different types of whisky during my downtime. Originally from San Diego, I love the sunny weather and the beach. My typical online hours are in the evenings after class or on weekends. I'm currently single and focusing on my studies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of electrical engineering concepts from my introductory courses at UCSD. I also have a keen interest in blacksmithing, which I started learning through online tutorials and local workshops. My exploration of whisky is more of a casual hobby, where I enjoy trying different brands and learning about the distillation process.
